title: androsace vitaliana subsp. assoana
intro: Androsace vitaliana subsp. assoana, commonly known as the Pyrenean rock jasmine, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Androsace vitaliana subsp. assoana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, that may help to modulate immune response, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and confirm its therapeutic potential.
